svg.title: Coming up: the first beacon, Connect, the match
svg.desc: The vehicle starts on configuration A with its restart flag set and sends beacon 1; tcsmoc shows the indicator green and Restarted, connect, and is not matched. The operator presses Connect, which sends CONNECT with A. The checksums match, so the vehicle clears the flag, opens the downlink, answers that it is running A and sends beacon 2, normal, at once. tcsmoc says the vehicle agrees, becomes matched for commanding with beacon 2, and sends one QUERY_NODE per panel; the answers make each panel Active. From then each node's data is read into its panel and the plot.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold
